plain.li: The question is whether this place can stand on its own.
Some of us would stay, and some of us would go.
If we hand it over, it is theirs to run, not ours.
Think about who you would be living with afterwards.
Say what you think now, while it still counts.
[speaker] We will count every voice before anything is decided.
[speaker] Nobody leaves this table without being heard.
[tribal] The fire stays here whoever keeps it.
[medieval] A charter of its own would make this a free town.
[industrial] It would be a township with its own mayor.
[spacer] It would run as an administration of its own.

warm.li: Whatever we choose, we will still be friends.

blunt.li: Either we trust them to run it, or we don't.

gloomy.li: I never thought we would be talking about splitting up.

cheerful.li: A town of our own people is not a bad thing to leave behind.

cold.li: Count the votes and let us get on with it.

plain.li: From today this place stands on its own, and it will look after its own.
Those who go are welcome back here whenever they come.
We will keep the fields and the walls as you left them.
Nobody here forgets who built this place.
Send word when you have settled, and we will send ours.
[tribal] We keep the fire, and you carry its embers with you.
[tribal] The totem stays with this fire and those who keep it.
[medieval] By this charter the town is free and answers for itself.
[medieval] We hold the keys now, and the gate stays open to you.
[industrial] The town charter is signed, and the old flag comes down.
[industrial] We will run the township as carefully as you ran the colony.
[spacer] The charter is registered and the codes are ours from today.
[spacer] The systems stay up, and your channel stays open.

warm.li: You are our people still, wherever you live.

blunt.li: It is ours to run now, and we will run it.

gloomy.li: It will be quieter here without you.

cheerful.li: A new name over the gate, and the same people under it.

cold.li: We know what has to be done, and we will do it.

plain.li: It is yours now, look after it.
Take it, and keep this place well.
[tribal] The totem is yours to keep by this fire.
[medieval] Here are the keys and the charter, and the town is yours.
[industrial] Here is the town charter, signed, and the flag is yours to raise.
[spacer] The codes are yours, and the charter is registered.

warm.li: There is nobody I would rather hand it to.

plain.li: We will keep it well, I promise you that.
It is in good hands, go safely.
[tribal] The fire will not go out while I keep it.
[medieval] The keys stay here and the gate stays open to you.
[industrial] We will keep the town running, you have my word.
[spacer] Codes received, and your channel stays open.

warm.li: Come back whenever you like, this is still your home.

plain.li: [going] I will write as soon as we are settled.
[going] Look after yourself while I'm gone.
[going] It won't be the same without you there.
[staying] Come and see us when you can.
[staying] There will always be a place at our table for you.
[staying] Go safely, and send word.

warm.li: [going] You were the best part of this place.
[staying] I'll miss you more than I can say.

blunt.li: [going] Don't let them run it into the ground.
[staying] Don't get yourself killed out there.

gloomy.li: [going] I keep thinking this is the last time I'll see you.
[staying] I hope we did the right thing.
